Hoshi wo Sagashite....name: Hoshi wo Sagashite...
Hoshi wo Sagashite....summary: The game revolves around a dog and his family. Being one of the earliest adventure games for an 8-bit console system, the game tends to be simplistic compared to today's adventure games. As a Japan exclusive video game, literacy is required in the Japanese language in order to play the game. The character seems to have an anime-like influence as the people are watching out for the dog that is sitting on a log. Among the human beings, however, is an alien-like creature. While the literal translation would be Searching the Stars..., the actual alternative title is The Story of Mio.

Streets of Rage.name: Streets of Rage
Streets of Rage.summary: The 8-bit port of Streets of Rage, released originally for the Sega Game Gear.
